address: 4-6 Islington Green, Islington, London, N1 2XA, United Kingdom
bio: Start with the delicious homemade focaccia and share some starters before ordering the USP: generous pasta dishes which invariably hit the spot, such as veal & pork Genovese ragu or brown butter cacio e pepe. The menus are fairly priced, as are the cocktails, making this a useful pitstop in this busy part of Islington. You’ll leave feeling sated and satisfied....
